SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(prc_usd) n_usd, COUNT(prc) n_prc, AVG(prc_usd) avg_usd, AVG(prc)/100.0 avg_prc_over_100 FROM items_g2

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) both_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_only,
  MIN(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN prc END) prc_only_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN prc END) prc_only_max,
  MIN(prc_usd) usd_min, MAX(prc_usd) usd_max, MIN(prc) prc_min, MAX(prc) prc_max,
  AVG(prc)/100.0 avg_prc_all, AVG(prc_usd) avg_usd_all
FROM items_g2
SELECT ref_id, ttl, prc, prc_usd, main_cat FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(prc)/100.0 FROM items_g2) avg_prc_all_dollars,
  (SELECT AVG(prc_usd) FROM items_g2) avg_prc_usd,
  (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(prc_usd, prc/100.0)) FROM items_g2) avg_coalesce,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL) unpriced,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL OR prc_usd IS NOT NULL) priced
SELECT ROUND(AVG(prc) / 100.0, 4) AS avg_listed_price_usd, COUNT(prc) AS priced_items FROM items_g2
